name: Model Retry Policy
description: Chooses what KiroCrew does when the model or its API fails transiently (throttling, overload, 5xx, dropped stream) instead of the fixed three retries: a retry count of your own, retry forever at a fixed interval, retry forever with exponential backoff, or a fallback profile that moves to other models after N retries (and optionally never gives up on the last). Applies to dashboard chats (including errors that land mid-turn, after text or a tool call has streamed), cron/Slack turns and sub-agents. Opt-in backend failover: when a dashboard chat's same-model retries are spent, the chat is moved to another agent backend that serves the SAME model (kiro-cli, KAS, Claude Code, Codex — as Agent Backend Router's served lists allow and Agent Backend Doctor confirms the backend is usable), the conversation replayed by KiroCrew's own provider-switch replay; the model never changes. Unofficial.

agent-backend-doctor.reason: answers whether a failover target is usable right now (installed, its cached 'not found' cleared, a Bedrock-backed Codex's credential chain intact) before a throttled chat is moved there

agent-backend-router.reason: the backend failover needs the router's served-list rule and route requests; without it the mechanism stays off and the page says so
